what: 64 gradient pills, tilted ±8° on alternate ones, are joined by a white thread (65px, ±16°). As soon as they attach, the thread shows through and shortens to 26px over 1.2s while the pills stand upright, and the band slides from −100% to −50% of one set width as the gap narrows from 64 to 25px (2.4s sine.inOut). After that line it flows half its width to the right over 70 seconds and loops endlessly — a grass-blade band laid along the bottom of the loader and Hero

options.count: Pill count, default 64 — must be a multiple of 16 so the half-turn seam lines up. [data-fx-part=pill] if you place a child directly, that one is used
options.tilt: Initial tilt (deg), default 8 — alternate items −/+, the thread goes the opposite way at double that
options.dur: Rise duration (s), default 2.4 — the sheer fade is half of that
options.flow: Seconds for the line’s rear half-width to flow, default 70
options.gap-from · gap: Pill gap at start and end (px), default 64 · 25 (phone 16)
options.thread-from · thread: White thread start and end length (px), default 65 · 26 (phone 56 · 17)
options.delay: Delay (sec), default 0 — .3 when paired with a loading bar
options.on: If scroll, plays once when the wrapping panel reaches 80% of the screen (default is as soon as it is attached)
options.--fx-pill-1 ~ --fx-pill-4: Four pairs of pill gradients (css) — default from accent, peach and white. From the fifth on, the same pairs are flipped vertically
options.--fx-w · --fx-h-l · --fx-h-m · --fx-h-s: Pill width and large, medium, small heights (css), default 65 · 236 · 206 · 176px (phone 44 · 160 · 140 · 120)

note: Under reduced motion it stays in a line shape and does not flow. The flow stops when the wrapping panel is off screen

from.where: shared.js loading #s-grass-top (original Loading.astro: xPercent −100→−50, gap 0 64→25px, --grass-opacity 1.2s, --grass-line 65→26px, rotation ±8°/±16°→0, 2.4s sine.inOut, then a 70s straight half turn repeats) — the four pairs of sky, mint, lemon and aqua use --fx-pill-1~4.
from.options: data-fx-pill-grass-band="count: 64; delay: .3" style="--fx-pill-1: var(--site-grass-1); --fx-pill-2: var(--site-grass-2); --fx-pill-3: var(--site-grass-3); --fx-pill-4: var(--site-grass-4)"
